variants.headline: Home-world ship reaches the colony
variants.sub: The colony has received the arrival of a home-world ship.
variants.body:
A ship from the home world has arrived in {colony}. The arrival is a concrete event in the colony's connection with its distant origin. Readers considering {target} should distinguish that fact from assumptions about particular goods, passengers or immediate changes in local supply not specified in this report.

Our movement sees the home-world connection as a relationship between people as well as an item of transport. An arrival deserves attention to the common purposes that connection serves. A principled political account should keep those purposes visible without treating a vessel as proof that every local need is met.

The contribution of {target} should be examined through the reported arrival. This paper does not attribute an unspecified commercial or household consequence to the vessel's presence in the colony. Political principle should remain visible when judgment becomes less comfortable.
